# EFF's long word list

`eff_large_wordlist.txt` is the Electronic Frontier Foundation's long list for passphrases, 7,776 words, five dice to a word, as it came from https://www.eff.org/files/2016/07/18/eff_large_wordlist.txt on 2026-10-26 (SHA-256 `addd35536511597a02fa0a9ff1e5284677b8883b83e986e43f15a3db996b903e`). The iPhone app makes passphrases from it.

It is published under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 United States licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/). Word list by the Electronic Frontier Foundation, from "EFF's New Wordlists for Random Passphrases" (2016). Nothing in it was changed.
